## Step 2. Fix the grader and extend the selftest

The selftest missed the bug because its oracle copies the reference labels exactly, so they are always uppercase. I also check `gradeCategory`. If it compares raw strings too, I apply the same fix in this commit and F7 covers both.

`spe/evals/harness/grader.js` (changed hunk):
```js
// Labels are compared after trim and case normalization. See spe/failures.md F7.
function normPriority(x) {
  return String(x ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
}
function gradePriority(output, reference) {
  const got = normPriority(output.priority);
  if (!/^P[1-4]$/.test(got)) {
    return { pass: false, reason: `invalid priority: ${JSON.stringify(output.priority)}` };
  }
  const want = normPriority(reference.priority);
  return { pass: got === want, got, want };
}
```

`spe/evals/harness/grader.selftest.js` (added cases):
```js
// F7: case and whitespace variants of the right label must pass.
assertPass(gradePriority({ priority: "p1" }, { priority: "P1" }));
assertPass(gradePriority({ priority: " P2 " }, { priority: "P2" }));
// Wrong, empty, and out-of-range labels must still fail.
assertFail(gradePriority({ priority: "p3" }, { priority: "P1" }));
assertFail(gradePriority({ priority: "" }, { priority: "P1" }));
assertFail(gradePriority({ priority: "high" }, { priority: "P1" }));
```
